{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    if not pts: return grid
    ar,ac=pts[0]; col=grid[ar][ac]
    tw=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    # locate bounding 2x2 corner containing the distinguished cell
    rs=[r for r,c in tw+[(ar,ac)]]; cs=[c for r,c in tw+[(ar,ac)]]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    corner=(ar-r0,ac-c0)
    base=[[0,0,9,9,9,0,0,0,0],[0,9,9,9,0,0,0,0,0],[9,9,9,9,0,0,0,0,0],[9,9,9,9,9,0,0,0,0],[9,0,0,9,9,9,0,0,0],[0,0,0,0,9,9,9,0,0],[0,0,0,0,0,9,9,9,0],[0,0,0,0,0,0,9,9,9],[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9,9]]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(9):
      for c in range(9):
       if base[r][c]:
        dr,dc=r-1,c-1
        if corner==(0,1): dr,dc=dc,-dr
        elif corner==(1,0): dr,dc=-dc,dr
        elif corner==(1,1): dr,dc=-dr,-dc
        rr,cc=ar+dr,ac+dc
        if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out"}
